name: White Pantsu
source:
Futaba has just moved to a new place with her brother. Her kitten ran away and Futuaba got lost. She was found out by seller of pants Rika and delivered to the brother. Choices determine in which direction the story goes from there on.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
双叶刚刚和哥哥搬到了新地方。她的小猫逃跑了，Futuaba迷路了。她被裤子卖家Rika发现并交给了哥哥。选择决定了故事从此发展的方向。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
